heading: I turn ideas into dependable digital products.
paragraphs: I’m a full-stack developer who likes to understand the whole product—not just one part of the codebase. I can take an idea from early requirements and architecture through development, deployment, and ongoing improvement.

My work moves naturally between polished interfaces, backend systems, APIs, databases, authentication, payments, AI integrations, and cloud infrastructure. Seeing the complete picture helps me make better technical decisions at every layer.
I care about building software that works well beyond launch: clear code, secure APIs, reliable data, and an architecture the team can confidently maintain and extend as the product grows.
